SitecoreCommander._commentTransferAuthModes: Transfer auth modes: Auto, Jwt, UserJson, ApiKey.
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferAuthModeAuto: Auto selects auth in this order: localhost+ApiKey => ApiKey, then Jwt (if client credentials are set), then UserJson (if XMCloudUserJsonPath exists), then ApiKey (if configured).
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferAuthModeJwt: Jwt uses Transfer*JwtClientId + Transfer*JwtClientSecret to request a bearer token (best for unattended cloud automation).
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferAuthModeUserJson: UserJson reads accessToken from XMCloudUserJsonPath and optionally selects endpoint via Transfer*UserJsonEnvironmentName.
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferAuthModeApiKey: ApiKey sends sc_apikey from Transfer*ApiKey (useful for local Sitecore CM scenarios).
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferSourceAuthMode: Source auth mode: Auto | Jwt | UserJson | ApiKey
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferSourceUserJsonEnvironmen: Optional endpoint key from user.json endpoints (for example: xmcloud-acc). Empty uses EnvironmentName/defaultEndpoint.
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferSourceApiKey: Optional API key used when source mode resolves/is set to ApiKey.
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferDestinationAuthMode: Destination auth mode: Auto | Jwt | UserJson | ApiKey
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferDestinationUserJsonEnvir: Optional endpoint key from user.json endpoints (for example: xmcloud-acc). Empty uses EnvironmentName/defaultEndpoint.
SitecoreCommander._commentTransferDestinationApiKey: Optional API key used when destination mode resolves/is set to ApiKey.
